# MapPool

Keeps round start from picking a map that can't load. Caelestinus Central (`Frontier`), the only map in
`DefaultMapPool`, has no player cap and is the fallback map; upstream Saltern is no longer a fallback. Before this,
more than 100 connected players made Frontier ineligible, round start fell back to Saltern, which fails to load on
this fork, and the server restarted the round in a loop. `WGMapPoolTest` checks that every fallback map is in the
default pool and that each votable preset's pool takes a full server.
